diagrams.title: Entity-Relationship Diagram for Football Match Management
diagrams.description: Entity-relationship model for the football match management system
diagrams.mermaid_code:
erDiagram
	MATCH-01 {
		UUID id PK
		UUID homeTeamId FK
		UUID awayTeamId FK
		DateTime dateTime
		String venue
		UUID leagueId FK
		Enum status
		Integer homeScore
		Integer awayScore
		DateTime lastUpdated
	}
	TEAM-01 {
		UUID id PK
		String name
		String abbreviation
		URL crestUrl
		Integer foundedYear
	}
	LEAGUE-01 {
		UUID id PK
		String name
		String sport
		String country
		URL logoUrl
		String currentSeason
	}
	USER-01 {
		UUID id PK
		String email
		String displayName
		URL avatarUrl
		Boolean isActive
		DateTime createdAt
		DateTime lastLoginAt
	}
	USERFOLLOW-01 {
		UUID userId FK
		UUID matchId FK
		DateTime followedAt
		Boolean notificationsEnabled
	}
	MATCH-01 ||--o{ LEAGUE-01 : "belongs to"
	MATCH-01 }|--|{ TEAM-01 : "has two"
	TEAM-01 }|--|{ MATCH-01 : "participates in"
	USER-01 }|--|{ MATCH-01 : "can follow"
	USERFOLLOW-01 }|--|{ USER-01 : "belongs to"
	USERFOLLOW-01 }|--|{ MATCH-01 : "belongs to"
